description: This is a PHP source class file defining the Topic model within the Opencart system. It contains methods to retrieve individual topics and lists of topics from the database, with caching implemented to optimize performance.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Model class for handling CMS topics within the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific topic identified by its ID, utilizing cache to avoid redundant database queries.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active topics, ordered by sort order, utilizing cache to avoid redundant database queries.
